tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace && echo \"=== build.log tail ===\"; tail -15 build.log; echo; echo \"=== restart counts ===\"; for c in $(docker compose ps -q); do n=$(docker inspect $c --format '{{.Name}} {{.RestartCount}} {{.State.Status}}'); echo \"$n\"; done | sort; echo \"=== any errors in recent logs? ===\"; for s in id-front cabinet-front admin-front gateway; do echo \"-- $s --\"; docker logs --tail 3 workspace-$s-1 2>&1 | head -3; done", "description": "Check build log tail, restart counts, recent logs", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Verify build completion and container stability"}
